result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only genuine visual defect is in the bottom navigation, where the 'Orders' tab lacks an icon while its siblings (Home, Search, Profile) each have one, leaving an empty gap and misaligned labels. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the card cut off at the viewport bottom are expected scroll behavior and were not counted.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab has no icon above its label, whereas Home, Search and Profile each display an icon. This creates an empty vertical gap, makes the 'Orders' label sit higher than the other labels, and breaks the visual consistency of the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g., a receipt/bag outline in the same 24px style and gray color as the inactive tabs) above the 'Orders' label so all four tabs share identical icon+label structure and baseline alignment.

issues.description: Because the 'Orders' tab icon is missing, its text label is vertically offset relative to the other tab labels (Home/Search/Profile labels sit below their icons, Orders sits where an icon-plus-label block should be), producing uneven spacing across the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: After restoring the Orders icon, verify all tab labels align on the same baseline and that equal vertical padding is applied within each tab item.
